chunks.content: ## Adding Box Pleats in CLO: Step-by-Step Tutorial This section explains the detailed procedure for adding box pleats in CLO, focusing on using the box pleats tools in both 2D and 3D windows, proper fold setting, and simulation preparation. Key terminology includes "Edit Pleats tool," "fold fold tool," "free fold tool," "line split tool," and "simulation." --- ### Accessing and Preparing Pleats Files - Open the **Precious Files** folder and locate **F Adding Pleats** in Scene Details. - Double-click the **Box Pleats** file and drag it into either the 2D or 3D window. - Open the **Avid** file and drag it into the **Female VR folder**. - Open the **FVR Fifi** folder and drag the file into the 3D window. --- ### Using the Edit Pleats Tool - In the 2D window, activate the **Edit Pleats** tool. - On the center line (front and back), right-click the pleats and select **Open Edit Pleats**. - Open the other half of the pleats to work symmetrically. - The top of the pleats window displays the 2D pleats toolbar. - Select the 5th pleats icon from the toolbar to **lock the outline** of the pleats. - Use the **Talent tool** on the 2D pleats and drag it to the center line in the 3D window. - Use the **Rely Pleats** tool to drag the center line to align precisely. --- ### Setting Fold Direction and Folding Pleats - Select the **Flip Folder** on the 2D pleats toolbar and tilt the fold block. - Click near the skirt board in the 2D window and move the mouse; an arrow will appear indicating the fold direction. - Ensure the arrow passes completely through the skirt board to set the fold direction correctly. - Double-click to confirm the fold direction. - When the fold fold button appears, select the character model and click **OK**. - Repeat this process for the skirt back panel. --- ### Locking and Unlocking Outlines for Folding - In the 2D vertical toolbar, the mouse should stop at the 5th icon. - Select to **lock the outer outline** of the board, then unlock it as needed. - Use the **fold fold tool** from the 2D toolbar. - Move the mouse along the outline of the board and stop when the fold line reaches the side (this marks the front part of the fold line). - Click the starting point on the skirt board and drag the mouse along the board outline to create the fold line. --- ### Handling Folding Errors and Using the Free Fold Tool - If folding errors occur (e.g., improper folds), this is often due to the **fold fold tool** defaulting to 13 fold lines. - Use **Ctrl + Z** to undo incorrect folds. - Employ the **free fold tool** to manually adjust and fold most parts accurately. - Return to the fold fold tool afterward to finalize folds along the outline. - Complete fold lines by clicking the left mouse button at the stopping point.

chunks.content: --- ### Handling Folding Errors and Using the Free Fold Tool - If folding errors occur (e.g., improper folds), this is often due to the **fold fold tool** defaulting to 13 fold lines. - Use **Ctrl + Z** to undo incorrect folds. - Employ the **free fold tool** to manually adjust and fold most parts accurately. - Return to the fold fold tool afterward to finalize folds along the outline. - Complete fold lines by clicking the left mouse button at the stopping point. --- ### Additional Fold Adjustments with Line Split Tool - Use the **line split tool** to add folds at specific points. - Press the mouse button on the puzzle-like area, then move the mouse to desired fold locations. - Click to finalize fold splits. --- ### Panel Arrangement and Preparation for Simulation - In the 3D full-fledged toolbar, select the fourth toolbar icon to display arrangement points around the virtual model. - In the 2D window, select all panels using **Ctrl + A** or by framing the panels. - Move panels upward to reveal blocked arrangement points. - Arrange panels to align with these points. - Adjust panel positions using the purple bar in the **Shape Editor**. - Fine-tune the green circles to ensure evenness. - Hold **Ctrl** and click the left mouse button to facilitate easier folding. --- ### Running and Finalizing the Folding Simulation - Activate the simulation to test pleat folds. - After simulation completes, select the skirt version. - Right-click and choose **Remove Print** to clear any prints interfering with visualization. - Create the simulation by clicking on the **uchi.org** (likely a button or interface element for simulation creation). - Select the desired simulation model and double-click to generate the simulation. - Review the simulation results in the 3D window. --- ### Using Point-Shaped Ruler for Model Form Analysis - The simulation allows the use of a **point-shaped ruler** tool for evaluating the model’s form. - This tool assists in precise measurement and analysis of the pleated garment shape during simulation. --- This tutorial guides CLO users through the technical process of adding and simulating box pleats on a skirt, emphasizing tool usage, fold direction setting, error correction, panel arrangement, and simulation finalization.
